comment: Pinned OpenList release the embedded Android runtime is taken from.
Desktop hosts keep downloading the same pinned release at first use; Android never downloads.
The Android payload is validated structurally (Android/Bionic ELF, expected ABI, loader, page
alignment), not with an extra checksum scheme: the trust boundary stays the pinned version plus
the official HTTPS release origin, the same one the desktop download path already uses.

android.sourceNote: Built by the official build.sh BuildReleaseAndroid: GOOS=android, NDK r26b *-linux-android24-clang, CGO_ENABLED=1, llvm-strip.
